title: CreateOrder without order.location_id answers 400 INVALID_REQUEST_ERROR / MISSING_REQUIRED_PARAMETER naming the field

source.note: Documented: the errors envelope and its four fields; `field` is 'The name of the field in the original request (if applicable) that the error pertains to'; INVALID_REQUEST_ERROR is 'The request was invalid. Most commonly, a required parameter was missing' (ErrorCategory); MISSING_REQUIRED_PARAMETER is 'The request is missing a required path, query, or body parameter' (ErrorCode); Order.location_id is marked Required. The page is silent on the HTTP status for MISSING_REQUIRED_PARAMETER (its status table covers only the 401/403 codes and 429) and on the dotted `order.location_id` spelling of `field`; the 400 and the spelling are the conventional reading.
